flags: WATERFRONT (downgrade, not a question): stored 'creekside' -> 'not waterfront'. Bald Hill Creek (5-9 m channel) runs 60-75 m west of the nearest west-loop units at ~47.3125,-98.1810 across mown grass with the loop road between; the six-RV row on the east loop (~47.3123,-98.1797) is ~150 m from the east channel and further from the west one. The only near water is a small dammed pond (~40 x 75 m, well under 5 acres) with a dock and swim area at the NW corner (~47.3130,-98.1815), which is a pond and its own day-use area - no value. ND Tourism's 'Lakefront' tag is rejected on the same grounds.
